narration.text: One planet completes a year in under 18 hours.
It's 55 Cancri e, a super-Earth hugging its star.
Announced in 2004, it was the first super-Earth around a main-sequence star.
Until 2010, astronomers thought its year lasted 2.8 days.
At that distance, rock itself may melt.
Life as we know it couldn't survive there.
So a planet's year length can tell you how hellish it is.
